components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for claim, save, send, and create actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563EB; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 600 14px/1.25 Segoe UI, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; transition: background 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1D4ED8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #CBD5E1; color: #64748B; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled field for pairing codes, names, filters, and rule values.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #0F172A; font: 600 12px/1.25 Segoe UI, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { background: #FFFFFF; color: #0F172A; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 12px; min-height: 44px; font: 400 14px/1.45 Segoe UI, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #2563EB; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.25); }

components.name: Device Card
components.description: A claimed device summary with name, category, and online/offline state.
components.css: .ds-device-card { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0F172A; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06); } .ds-device-card h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font: 600 16px/1.3 Segoe UI, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-device-card p { margin: 0; color: #475569; font: 400 14px/1.45 Segoe UI, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-online { color: #166534; background: #DCFCE7; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; font: 600 12px/1.25 Segoe UI, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Actuator Toggle
components.css: .ds-toggle-on { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 52px; min-width: 160px; background: #DBEAFE; color: #1D4ED8; border: 1px solid #93C5FD; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 14px; font: 600 14px/1.25 Segoe UI, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle-on:hover { background: #BFDBFE; } .ds-toggle-on:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.25); } .ds-toggle-on strong { font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar/top navigation item with selected state.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { min-height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; background: #DBEAFE; color: #1D4ED8; font: 600 14px/1.25 Segoe UI, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.25); }

narrative.overview: OmniConnect should feel like a calm SmartHome control room: status is visible, actions are close at hand, and technical depth stays available without interrupting everyday control. The interface is a product surface, not a marketing page; it earns trust through familiar controls, consistent density, clear labels, and restrained color.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained accent color used for action, selection, and state.
Standard product UI affordances before novelty.
Technical complexity hidden behind Advanced mode.
Clear status language for online/offline, telemetry, commands, automation, and notifications.

rules.name: The Accent Earns Its Place Rule
rules.body: Blue appears only where the user can act, where something is selected, or where state needs emphasis. If a surface is blue just to look designed, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Status Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red, and cyan are semantic state colors. Do not reuse them as decorative accents.

rules.name: The Product Type Rule
rules.body: Do not use display fonts, decorative fonts, or oversized hero typography. This is a control app, not a landing page.

rules.name: The Flat Until Touched Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are quiet at rest. Elevation increases only for hover, focus, menu, or dialog states.

dos: Do make Home the obvious starting point for device status, latest telemetry, actuator control, and notifications.
Do use Control Blue only for main actions, current selection, enabled controls, and meaningful state.
Do keep Advanced mode for raw telemetry, command logs, automation executions, and debugging.
Do show empty states that teach the next action, such as claiming a device with a pairing code.
Do design keyboard focus, loading, error, disabled, and success states for every interactive control.
donts: Don't make the primary experience look like a raw admin panel, Swagger replacement, database browser, or developer debug console.
Don't build identical card grids that do not reflect user tasks.
Don't use hero-metric templates as decoration.
Don't use colored side-stripe cards or alerts.
Don't expose raw IDs, capability keys, command names, or bitmasks in the normal user flow.
